_comment: Corrections applied on top of what build_indicators.py infers from the XLSForm. Keys are indicator ids in lower case. Anything you set here wins, and survives a rebuild of the registry.

ps6._why: Example. The form sets a target of 0 for the % of SEA/SH cases reported through the complaints mechanism, which reads as 'fewer reports is better'. If the intent is the opposite, flip it here.
